n5881a4eec9.headline: Euro zone recession fears harden as surveys show grim start to Q4 | Business
n5881a4eec9.summary: The euro-zone economy contracted 0.1% in the third quarter. The HCOB composite PMI fell to 46.5 in October, its lowest reading since November 2020.
n5881a4eec9.why: The PMI is a widely watched survey of business activity, and a reading below 50 signals contraction in the economy that sets the region's growth and rate outlook.

n3d59fa0b85.headline: ECG undertakes operation ‘fix the bill; pay the bill’ for post-paid customers
n3d59fa0b85.summary: The Electricity Company of Ghana will run a four-week drive to fix all post-paid meter billing challenges nationwide. The exercise is dubbed 'fix the bill; pay the bill'.
n3d59fa0b85.why: The Electricity Company of Ghana is the state utility that distributes power to most of the country, so billing accuracy affects its revenue collection and consumer confidence.

n40c38d48f0.headline: JUST IN: Kganyago adamant SARB will curb inflation
n40c38d48f0.summary: South African Reserve Bank governor Lesetja Kganyago said the central bank will not hesitate to do what is needed to preserve price stability, as inflation remains in focus.
n40c38d48f0.why: The South African Reserve Bank sets the country's interest rates, which influence the rand, government bond yields and borrowing costs across the economy.

n897cab84da.headline: Uganda's Yoweri Museveni hits back over expulsion from US-Africa trade pact Agoa
n897cab84da.summary: US President Joe Biden expelled Uganda from the African Growth and Opportunity Act trade deal last week after it passed a new anti-homosexuality law. Museveni has hit back.
n897cab84da.why: AGOA gives eligible sub-Saharan African countries preferential duty-free access to the US market, so losing eligibility affects exporters.

n592de57dca.headline: Focus on Iran
n592de57dca.summary: Iran claims wheat self-sufficiency but is grappling with bread prices, according to a world-grain.com report.
n592de57dca.why: Iran is a large importer of wheat in some years, and bread is a staple food subsidized in the country. Bread price pressure affects inflation and food security.

n917410a151.headline: IMF starts second review of Ukraine programme as Kyiv seeks over $41 billion
n917410a151.summary: The IMF mission has begun policy talks with Ukrainian officials on the second review of the $15.6 billion Extended Fund Facility loan. Kyiv is reportedly seeking over $41 billion.
n917410a151.why: The IMF lends to member countries under conditional programmes, and its reviews determine when disbursements are released, which affects Ukraine's financing and its bond and currency markets.

nb52eb8f51e.headline: The Istat picture: it is frozen on inflation in Italy. But growth is at zero
nb52eb8f51e.summary: Istat data shows Italian inflation fell from 5.3% in September to 1.8% in October. GDP showed zero growth, with a slight contraction of 0.1% cited in the report.
nb52eb8f51e.why: Istat is Italy's national statistics institute, and its inflation and GDP figures shape expectations for European Central Bank policy and Italian bond yields.

n2bdfd40e8b.headline: South Africa risks losing business investment over visa ‘chaos’
n2bdfd40e8b.summary: An acute shortage of skilled workers is restraining already tepid growth and pushing some foreign investors to consider moving money elsewhere. The skills shortage is ranked the second-biggest impediment to growth after power outages.
n2bdfd40e8b.why: South Africa is a major emerging-market economy whose growth is constrained by electricity supply and labour availability. Foreign investment flows affect its currency and bond markets.

n1243631a90.headline: Electricity minister calls for more rooftop solar tax incentives
n1243631a90.summary: Electricity minister Kgosientsho Ramokgopa called for batteries and inverters to be included in tax incentives for rolling out rooftop solar. The proposal concerns South Africa's energy policy.
n1243631a90.why: South Africa faces chronic electricity shortages, and incentives for rooftop solar and storage shape private energy investment and utility demand.

n372e8a62f5.headline: Inter-bank: rupee sees 11th successive fall against US dollar

n372e8a62f5.why: A prolonged slide in the rupee raises import costs for Pakistan and adds pressure on inflation and external debt servicing.

n8fb113fa32.headline: MTBPS shows SA needs a new government
n8fb113fa32.summary: The medium-term budget policy statement shows South Africa's debt-to-GDP ratio is set to hit 77%, compared with 23.5% in 2009. The figures underscore the fiscal strain facing the government.
n8fb113fa32.why: Debt-to-GDP measures government debt relative to economic output and shapes borrowing costs, credit ratings and the scope for fiscal policy.

na5b4870dbe.headline: Israel Intensifies Gaza Strikes Despite Ceasefire Calls

na5b4870dbe.why: The Israel-Hamas war is a major geopolitical risk that affects regional energy markets, shipping routes and investor sentiment toward the Middle East.
